text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was no room to think at all. Pouring 
every ounce of strength she had into the 
race, Tosen Jordan claims victory in the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet the Umamusume around her quickly 
analyzed their mistakes and began 
strategizing for the next race. To her, 
witnessing that was like peering into 
another dimension.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not a single word sank into her head. It 
was all difficult vocabulary, spoken by 
people who felt like they lived in another 
world—she couldn't understand any of it, 
and it terrified her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This victory was probably just a stroke of 
luck. Next time, I'll likely lose. And in 
a really uncool way at that. ...Because 
I'm just an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Next time," "the favorite"âplease, 
don't say those words. Her Trainer's 
voice, speaking of aiming for the Osaka 
Hai, couldn't reach her frightened heart.
